Subject: Configuration details for **My Dashboard**

The dashboard is identified by the title **My Dashboard** and uses the image file **dashboard.png** as its primary icon. The background color is set to a clean white (**#ffffff**) and all icons are rendered at a size of **64 px**. The chosen layout format for this view is **UDRW**, which determines how the elements are arranged on the screen.

Two interactive elements have been placed on the canvas. The first element sits at coordinates **(10, 20)** and functions as a hyperlink; clicking it will open **https://example.com** in the default browser. The second element is positioned at **(30, 40)** and is a file shortcut that points to the script located at **/usr/local/bin/script.sh**.
